Hangman pictures, word list and the original rules come from:

  https://github.com/simonjsuh/Vanilla-Javascript-Hangman-Game
  commit  9cd3289dcf0fc99841751c41b3fcc2b942cb3121
          (master, 2019-12-16)

vendor/hangman.js           original script (Bootstrap + innerHTML)
vendor/images/0.jpg … 6.jpg original gallows frames (PNG bytes, named .jpg)

Upstream loads Bootstrap from a CDN and the six frames as <img src>. GifOS's
runtime inlines <script src> and drops type="module", and the sandbox has
nowhere to fetch a CDN from. app.js is a classic-script port of the same
rules (one of fourteen programming-language words, six wrong guesses) plus
gifos.db persistence and versus (same word: race, or one shared gallows).
The frames travel inside the GIF. Nothing is fetched.

The notice COPYING-hangman.txt is packed inside the GIF as well as sitting
here.
